package.name: quad_cam
package.description: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 Wide publisher for the IBVS stack. Publishes bgr8 frames on /quad/camera/image_raw, ISP-downscaled to the module3wide_2304 render size so image_features runs unchanged from simulation. Backend is picamera2 (the RaspberryPi libcamera fork built to /usr/local); picamera2 has no rosdep key and is satisfied out-of-band - see RUNNING.md. Carries no simulation dependency, so it ships to the aircraft.
